full_prompt_en: A square, brightly brushed outdoor painting shows people strolling with dogs along a waterside promenade on a clear day. The background opens across the upper half to a vivid turquoise lake, with tiny dark boats and distant walkers marking the far shore. A soft blue sky carries a few broken pale clouds above the water. Along the left edge, slender bare tree trunks rise from the walkway and their branches sketch a loose lattice across the upper corner. The promenade sweeps from the lower-left foreground toward the center distance, its pale surface broken by long cool blue shadows. Small groups of people in dark coats, hats, cream dresses, and vivid orange garments stand or walk along the shore. Near the center-left, a woman in a saturated orange skirt stands beside a darker figure; a white dog moves at their feet. On the right foreground, a man in a long navy coat and dark hat pauses beside another white dog. Its pale body catches direct sun and contrasts with the man's shadowed clothes. More figures shrink into the distance beside the water, giving the broad public space a lively scale. The paint is applied in short, broken strokes: turquoise and sky-blue patches describe the lake, while cream, ocher, cobalt shadow, and occasional red-orange marks give the path and crowd their sparkling variation. Faces remain loosely indicated, with clothing color and posture carrying the sense of individual activity. Strong sun from high left casts distinct cool shadows across the walkway and brightens white fabric and dog coats. The overall composition is airy and bustling, using the diagonal promenade, blue water, repeated upright figures, and scattered warm accents to hold an animated leisure scene together.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、笔触明亮的户外绘画呈现人们在晴朗的一天带着狗沿湖滨步道散步。背景上半幅打开成鲜亮青蓝色湖面，细小深色船只和远处行人标出对岸。水面上方是柔和蓝天，飘着几块断续浅云。沿左边缘，纤细的无叶树干从路边升起，枝条在上角画出松散网格。步道从左下前景扫向中央远处，浅色表面被长长的冷蓝色阴影切开。穿深色外套、帽子、奶油色裙装和鲜亮橙色衣服的小群人物在岸边停留或走动。靠近中央偏左，一位穿饱和橙色裙子的女子站在较深色人物旁，脚边有一只白狗。右侧前景，一名穿深海军蓝长外套、戴深色帽子的男子停在另一只白狗旁。狗的浅色身体接住直射阳光，与男子处在阴影里的衣服对比。更多人物沿水边越退越小，使宽阔公共空间显得热闹且有尺度。颜料以短小断续笔触铺上：青蓝与天蓝色斑块描述湖面，奶油色、赭黄、钴蓝阴影和偶尔的红橙笔迹让小路与人群闪动变化。面部只被粗略指示，衣服颜色和姿态承担个人活动的感觉。强阳光从左上方照来，在步道上投出明确冷色长影，并提亮白布和狗毛。整体构图通透而繁忙，以斜向步道、蓝色湖水、重复的直立人物及零散暖色重音，把充满活动的休闲场景连成一体。
style_prompt_en: The outdoor oil painting uses short broken strokes and clear sunlit color to make every broad area flicker with variation. Turquoise, pale sky blue, cream, ocher, cobalt shadow, and concentrated red-orange accents sit side by side with little smooth blending. Upright marks repeat across a diagonal light plane, giving a sense of lively movement and increasing distance. Thin dark linear forms frame the open upper space without closing it. Strong daylight separates bright whites from long cool shadows, while loosely handled edges keep the scene fluid rather than photographic. Far details reduce to tiny marks; nearer strokes are broader and more distinct. The overall effect is airy and sociable, with bright color, rhythmic spacing, and visible brushwork carrying the visual style.
style_prompt_zh: 户外油画运用短小断续的笔触和清楚的阳光颜色，让每片大区域都因变化而闪动。青蓝、浅天蓝、奶油色、赭黄、钴蓝阴影和集中的红橙色重音并排放置，几乎不作平滑融合。直立笔迹在一片斜向浅色平面上反复出现，形成热闹运动和逐渐加深的距离感。纤细深色线性形体框住开放的上部空间，却没有把它封死。强日光将明亮白色与长长的冷色阴影分开，松动的边缘使场景保持流动，不显摄影式。远处细节缩成小小笔迹，近处笔触更宽、更清楚。整体效果通透而有人群交往气息，明亮色彩、节奏性间距和可见笔触承担主要画风。
theme_en: People strolling with dogs along a bright waterside promenade
theme_zh: 人们带着狗沿明亮的湖滨步道散步
name: Gifford Beal
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
